title: Union with Christ
definition: Union with Christ means believers are joined to Jesus by faith so that His life, death, resurrection, righteousness, and inheritance become theirs by grace.
summary: Union with Christ means believers are joined to Jesus by faith so that His life, death, resurrection, righteousness, and inheritance become theirs by grace.
christFocus: Jesus does not merely give benefits from a distance; He gives Himself, making His people one with Him by the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Union with Christ is one of the deepest realities of salvation. Believers are not merely forgiven on paper; they are joined to the risen Savior. What is His by grace becomes theirs: righteousness, life, sonship, hope, and future glory.

Scripture describes believers as in Christ, crucified with Christ, raised with Christ, and seated with Christ. This union is not emotional imagination but spiritual reality created by God through faith and the Holy Spirit.

Union with Christ gives identity stronger than shame, addiction, failure, disability, rejection, or past labels. The believer belongs to Jesus, and that changes everything about who they are and how they live.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people try to build identity from performance, pain, relationships, ministry success, or failure. Union with Christ gives a deeper identity: the believer's life is hidden with Christ in God.

This doctrine keeps discipleship from becoming self-improvement. Growth flows from belonging to Jesus and learning to live from His life by the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Remember that you do not follow Christ as an outsider trying to earn a place. You belong to Him. Let your union with Christ shape repentance, courage, holiness, endurance, and hope today.
